- **But the contact sets are identical** (step_05–step_08): the pre-change partner set of 1036 and 1163 and the post-change partner set of 1244 and 1366 are the exact same 30 nodes {65, 66, 74, 163, 232, 245, 292, 389, 422, 442, 526, 702, 848, 850, 880, 978, 986, 987, 990, 1200, 1317, 1358, 1456, 1566, 1587, 1633, 1681, 1780, 1888, 1999}. Jaccard(pre, post) = 30/30 = 1.0; zero old contacts retired, zero new contacts recruited.

A regime switch requires an *old set of contacts giving way to a new set*. Here the external neighbourhood is perfectly conserved across the candidate change point; only the internal relay of which group member does the contacting rotates. That is a persistent-partner structure, not a change of interaction partners.
